comment: The ships which Signe the shipwright builds in her shipyard, and how they row: the push of a stroke, how long the ship glides, how quickly it turns and how fast it can go, as shares of the small rowing boat; how far its bow reaches ahead (in metres, it must stay on the water); the hold in crates; the crew which rows to the players' beat; and how the ship is drawn (the painted longship, at this size, with or without a sail). See GameState and DESIGN.md, section 8.

ships.name: Rowing boat
ships.about: Grandmother's old boat: small, nimble, and yours.

ships.name: Færing
ships.about: A light four-oared boat: two of my rowers pull with you.

ships.name: Karve
ships.about: A small ship with six rowers and a square sail which keeps her gliding.

ships.name: Knarr
ships.about: The trading ship: wide and deep, she carries forty crates, but she turns slowly.

ships.name: Longship
ships.about: Twenty rowers and a great sail: the fastest ship on the lakes.
